meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, studies of company finances (DBIE, via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each study is final for its own sample of companies; a later study re-measures the earlier year on a different sample, kept beside it, never chained.
meta.coverage: Foreign direct investment companies: financial ratios, by industry, from the RBI's annual studies (2012-13 to 2018-19 studies)
meta.note: The figure for a year as re-measured in the study 2 years later, on that later study's sample. Kept apart from the year's own study (the bundle without -prior), never mixed.
